summary: Segmented control for choosing a plan or billing cycle.
whenToUse: Offering a compact choice between plan alternatives.
whenNotToUse: Comparing prices and features together: use PricingTable.
accessibility: The group has an accessible name.
The choice is exposed with aria-pressed and remains controlled by the caller.
responsive: Options wrap when space is limited.
commonMistakes: Expecting the value to change without updating the value prop.
